task_success_checks: 3 s consecutive geometric, contact, orientation, velocity, robot-release checks
readback: first and last frame of every LeRobot episode
source: scripted simulator-state expert; not human demonstrations

diversity.method: 24 arclength samples per active arm per phase; mean Euclidean TCP distance; no timing credit
diversity.interpretation: Descriptive coverage metrics only; no estimate of independent sample count or learned-policy success.

limitations: simulated camera and dynamics not calibrated to hardware

layout_coverage.layout_distance_definition: Minimum mean Euclidean XY distance over all 6 cube matchings; ignores color.
